denominator.note: 69/69 broad candidates have source-bound agent dispositions, not approved mappings. Overlap, ambiguous identities and usefulness remain unresolved.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Identity verification, permission decisions and activity records are separate roles.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Recall the identity/access/activity vocabulary; it does not teach control-function classification or diagnose a mistaken answer.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Permission rules allow or deny access to an object or network resource.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Recognize access-list terminology; this is not rule ordering practice or a proof that every access list has one control function.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: A policy describes permitted and forbidden use of organizational systems.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Recognize policy purpose; no direct directive/managerial classification, enforcement or policy-development skill is taught.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Security goals concern disclosure, unwanted change and service availability.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Fundamental vocabulary can refresh the three goals. Canonical alias choice remains withheld; this is not control-type mastery.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: The resource owner controls access decisions.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Differentiate owner discretion from centrally imposed labels at definition level; no scenario application is provided.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: The card specifically describes centrally imposed labels and policy for access.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Useful access-model reminder only after a scoped identity exists. The canonical MAC node is overloaded with networking meanings; do not merge them.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Job-role membership governs permission assignment.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Role and rule cards must stay separate meanings. One generic RBAC identity cannot resolve their distinct mechanisms.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Conditions such as device, location or time determine permissions.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: This is rule logic, not job-role membership. Similar acronym recall is not evidence of distinguishing the mechanisms.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: The delivered card describes permitted access windows.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Withhold the TOU identity: this local time-window meaning differs from the official race-condition time-of-use term. No 2.3 race-condition teaching or mastery may be inferred.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Identity, allowed actions and activity records are summarized.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Short vocabulary reminder; no evidence that the learner can apply each role in a new scenario.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Permit/deny rules can control file, device and network access.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: A short access-list contrast can support terminology after a miss, but not configuration, rule ordering or control classification.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Policy sets limits on organizational system use.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Policy meaning only; no independent directive-function outcome, management decision or governance competence.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Surveillance is described as physical security with detective and deterrent functions.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Limited purpose reminder for m102; the definition does not explain why a warning sign is deterrent whereas recording detects. Do not assume every camera always supplies both functions.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Three fundamental protection goals form the security triad.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Alias identity remains withheld. Definition exposure cannot prove discrimination among applied goals.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Access discretion belongs to the resource owner.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: A brief model distinction without permissions practice; overlaps the delivered DAC card.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Key-based reversible transformation protects readable information.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Refresh encryption vocabulary; does not establish key management, algorithm choice, integrity or data-recovery competence.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: The same inline token offers both mandatory access and network hardware-address meanings.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: The current definition mixes distinct domains. Require context and owner identity split before any precise support attribution.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Authentication uses multiple different kinds of factor.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Factor vocabulary may support m601 only as an unvalidated editorial hypothesis. It does not explain technical-category classification or compensating alternatives in m003/m203.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: The definition identifies a standards and framework publisher.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Agency recognition is background context. It does not teach a specific framework, compliance obligation or every objective appearing in its source-reference union.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: The inline definition combines job roles and conditional permission rules.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Withhold precise canonical support until role-based and rule-based meanings are separated. A combined acronym popover cannot validate either mechanism.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Central collection and correlation of logs support event detection.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Tool-purpose vocabulary can help an accounting/logging contrast, but not incident diagnosis, tool configuration or an approved detective mastery identity.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: An application-layer web filter can identify and stop malicious requests.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Device purpose only; no product selection or applied request analysis. m402 has a metadata WAF match but none in rendered question/option/feedback prose, so its tooltip is not proven there.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Location alone does not establish trust for users, devices and access.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: A model reminder only; not a proof of policy-engine design or a single mandated authentication method for every request.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Container groups different security and access meanings; it is not an independently assessed concept.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Broad inherited tags and lesson rankings do not identify which precise concept a learner missed.

selectorBindings.limitation: Includes three mobile quick sets, saved/shared deck restoration and explicit deck/mode choice. Stored learner instances are excluded.
Term/acronym/example presentation, pass navigation and related lesson/deck actions reuse authored content. Self-rating is not trusted mastery evidence.
Definitions are conditional inline support; corpus matches do not prove a browser tooltip was opened.
Includes free-preview gating, lesson search, guided steps and related flashcard end action. Other lesson end actions delegate to separately inventoried selectors.
Selection, dividers and saved-ID hydration reuse authored cards. Saved user deck contents are excluded.
Terms, objective overlap and domain matching; no canonical adaptive mapping dependence.
Selection algorithm included; personal selections are not catalogue revisions and are not queried.
Broad topic matching and chapter fallback; no adaptive canonical concept map is consulted.

deliveryLimitations: All nine authored cards are reachable through the free standard deck; study modes reveal/reuse the same content. They have no scenario examples. Local or synced Got it labels are self-ratings, not attested mastery. No learner state was read or written.

Glossary references in the package scan every string including metadata and card text. Actual card faces use plain JSX, not GlossaryText. Metadata/source matches alone cannot prove inline definition delivery. Each of the 14 definitions has one separate source-bound MCQ rendered-field probe; no browser popover opening is claimed.

Random/starred/weak-area selectors reuse authored cards. Weak-area decks use legacy chapter/topic/token matches and related lessons use broad text/objective/domain ranking, not canonical diagnosis. Saved or personalized learner instances are outside scope.
Related lesson access is gated; optional CSF context remains beyond textbook in the prior lesson slice. No unused helper card or extra generated check is added to this 24-record denominator.

decisions: CIA alias choice withheld for card and glossary.
MAC access-model card is precise but the canonical acronym is overloaded; mixed inline definition also stays withheld.
Role-based and rule-based cards retain distinct meanings; the shared RBAC node and mixed glossary cannot resolve them.

TOU card teaches an access window, unlike official objective 2.3 time-of-use race conditions. Withhold sy0701.term.tou, retain 4.6 context as a proposal, and require separate editorial correction before claiming official acronym alignment.
